_comment: Hand-curated Penn Manor community events. Cowork weekly scans https://www.pennmanor.net/community/ for datebound community events and opens a PR proposing candidates as status:'pending' entries here. User reviews the PR on GitHub (mobile or web), changes status to 'approved' for events to publish, then merges. Only status:'approved' entries become real events on the site; everything else (pending, rejected, missing status) is silently ignored.
_format: Each entry: title (required), date (ISO with Eastern offset, required), status ('pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected', defaults to skip), endTime (optional, ISO), location (optional, defaults to 'Penn Manor'), description (optional), sourceLink (optional, defaults to the community page), image (optional), price (optional, defaults to 'Free'), registrationRequired (optional bool — shows 'Registration required' badge on card), registrationDeadline (optional ISO with Eastern offset — event auto-hides past this time). Stale entries (>30 days past) auto-skipped — no need to prune.
